Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.1242-0.1270 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.1280; the first objective pays 2.76R at 0.1231.

Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.2096-0.2105 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation.
